posts.text: 💳 Agentic Commerce Black Friday will put AI shopping agents to the test. Consumers aren’t buying it yet Fortune · 2h ago • Black Friday 2024 will test whether AI shopping agents can drive consumer adoption. Consumer skepticism toward AI shopping tools remains a barrier to widespread use. Event presents key opportunity to validate AI agent capabilities in real-world retail environment. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry The absolute best Black Friday deals we’ve found (so far) The Verge · 25m ago • Black Friday deals have rolled out in waves and are now widely available across multiple categories. Discounts span video games, earbuds, TVs, e-readers, and robot vacuums both in-store and online. This year's sale period extended over several weeks rather than single day. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry AI Helps Merchants Stop Holiday Fraud Without Losing Good Customers PYMNTS · 1h ago • AI fraud prevention systems help retailers balance risk acceptance and customer retention during peak shopping. Black Friday creates unique economic challenge for fraud detection due to transaction volume and patterns. AI enables merchants to minimize false rejections of legitimate purchases. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry Small AI Models Give Banks a Way to Keep Sensitive Data In-House PYMNTS · 1h ago • Smaller AI models enable banks to process sensitive data locally without cloud infrastructure. Recent releases from Thinking Machines, PrismML, and Sarvam support laptop and single-chip deployment. Shift away from large data center models reflects growing focus on privacy and efficiency. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry Why did an AI chip frenzy send a Chinese blender maker’s stock soaring 370%? SCMP – Tech · 🌏 Asia · 1h ago • Joyoung, a Chinese appliance maker, saw stock surge 370% due to AI chip investment frenzy. Retail investors confused AI GPU demand with the company's actual business in soy milk makers. Demonstrates speculative behavior in Chinese markets around AI sector exposure. Read more →

Program aims to expand Kimi model usage in academic research community. Initiative seeks to build researcher adoption for Chinese AI platform. Read more →

Layoffs represent significant shift in company's strategic priorities. 📰 Also covered by: Analytics India Magazine Read more →
